summary:
Hugging Face is the model hub at huggingface.co. The hugging-face emoji in the tab is the icon developers bookmark for model and dataset pages.

Checked 12 November 2026 against huggingface.co. HTML came from https://huggingface.co/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://huggingface.co/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 205556 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 24×24, 32×32, 48×48, 64×64, 72×72, 96×96, 128×128, 256×256.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #ffdd11 comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-256x256-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 43678 bytes) from https://huggingface.co/favicon.ico.
